Skia shadow geometry subset
==========================

Upstream: https://skia.googlesource.com/skia
Revision: 765d2043b9674d376b414904d4b3dc21760874df
License: BSD-style, in LICENSE.

Copied files (only include paths/dependencies changed):
  src/utils/SkShadowTessellator.{h,cpp}
  src/utils/SkPolyUtils.{h,cpp}
  src/core/SkTInternalLList.h
  src/core/SkTDPQueue.h
  src/core/SkDrawShadowInfo.{h,cpp}

SkDrawShadowInfo omits GetLocalBounds, which is used by Skia's resource cache, not kiln.
SK_GANESH selects the original curve-subdivision branch of the tessellator; no Ganesh
renderer is linked.

Extracted helpers:
  SkCurves.{h,cpp}: GrPathUtils' quadratic/cubic point generators, the Wang's formula
  pieces they use, SkConic subdivision/conversion/TransformW, and SkAutoConicToQuads.
  Original files: src/gpu/ganesh/geometry/GrPathUtils.{h,cpp},
  src/gpu/tessellate/WangsFormula.h, src/core/SkGeometry.{h,cpp}.
  Vector arithmetic is expanded componentwise. Small-array storage uses std::vector.

  skia_compat.h: the used portions of SkPoint/SkPointPriv/SkPoint3, SkRect/SkRectPriv,
  SkMatrix (including perspective concatenation/mapping), SkPath::Iter, floating-point
  and packed-colour helpers. Original files: include/core/Sk{Point,Point3,Rect,Matrix,Path}.h,
  src/core/Sk{Point,Rect,Matrix,Path}.cpp, src/core/Sk{PointPriv,RectPriv,ColorData}.h,
  include/private/SkFloatingPoint.h, include/core/SkScalar.h.
  Skia containers/ref-counted meshes are replaced with STL storage and a small mesh
  holder; non-movable intrusive-list grids are constructed in place, without relocation.
  The path iterator tracks its current conic weight without forming a pointer before
  the beginning of the weights array. Unused API and debug machinery are omitted.

  SkMaskBlur.{h,cpp}: A8-only scalar adaptation of SkMaskBlurFilter's PlanGauss
  (same three running sums and 32-bit fixed-point normalization) and small_blur
  (same Bessel factors, 8.8 products and per-axis rounding). The Gaussian scan
  advances forward through a zero tail instead of processing from both ends.
  Original files: src/core/SkMaskBlurFilter.cpp and src/core/SkGaussFilter.{h,cpp}.

Integration outside this directory:
  core/src/kiln/graphics/PathShadow.cpp adapts kiln paths/matrices and ports the
  SkDevice::drawShadow blur fallback from src/utils/SkShadowUtils.cpp.
  render/shaders/tri.frag ports SkGaussianColorFilter's Gaussian alpha-to-grayscale
  effect from src/gpu/ganesh/GrFragmentProcessors.cpp.
